assets.name: male-core
assets.prompt:
Create an extensive 12-expression CHARACTER CONCEPT SHEET for the adult man in reference image1, reimagined in the bold flat SVG-style game illustration of reference image2.
REFERENCE ROLES: image1 establishes MALE CHARACTER IDENTITY (tousled dark black-brown hair, warm brown/tan skin, dark brown eyes, thick heavy expressive eyebrows, distinctive substantial nose, light moustache and chin stubble, oversized dark wrapped scarf, weathered dark leather shoulder gear with one muted bronze clasp). Image2 is STYLE ONLY: bold simplified curved ink, flat cel colors, exaggerated facial elasticity. DO NOT copy the woman's blue hair, markings, armour design, eye color or face.
Clean landscape ivory concept sheet, 4 columns x 3 rows, exactly12 generously spaced LARGE HEAD-AND-SHOULDER drawings. Same man consistently throughout, same clothing and hair direction. No panel frames. One tiny clear label below each head. No other text. All drawings have complete hair and shoulder margins.
Restrained palette: dark charcoal ink, warm medium tan skin and single ochre shadow, almost-black brown hair with one soft brown fill accent, muted aubergine-black scarf, warm slate leather, bronze clasp, off-white teeth. Thick confident dark exterior curves, thinner interior drawing. 2 tones maximum per material. NO gradients, painterly texture, stubble dots, individual hair strands, polished anime rendering. Hair simplified into 5-6 chunky messy tufts. Stubble as simple flat connected chin/upper-lip shapes, not realistic hair.
He is a scruffy, sensitive adult adventurer who tries to be brave; use strong brow shapes and a big squashy expressive nose. Clearly adult, not baby chibi.
POSES in reading order:
01 REST: thoughtful slightly worried resting face, brows asymmetrically raised.
02 CURIOUS: head leans forward/tilts, one brow high, little parted lips.
03 SUSPICIOUS: compressed eyelids, sideways eye direction, chin drawn back.
04 SMUG: one corner grin, chin tipped up, half-lidded asymmetry.
05 WARM SMILE: full cheeks and soft lids, gentle asymmetrical smile.
06 DELIGHT: cheeks push head wide, broad open grin, eyebrows high.
07 LAUGHTER: head back, huge open laughing mouth, squeezed crescents, shoulders raised.
08 SURPRISE: eyes round, small O mouth, head lifted above scarf.
09 PANIC: head and jaw stretch 150 percent tall, huge open dark mouth, pinprick pupils, scarf catches under chin.
10 ANNOYED: face sinks into scarf, flat mouth and heavy lids.
11 ANGRY: low brows, clenched teeth, wide compressed jaw, forward thrust.
12 FURIOUS: over-the-top wide jaw shout and angular brow, head projected forward, nose wrinkled, shoulders bunched.
Change skull, cheeks, nose, jaw, neck and hair silhouette with acting, not just different features on an identical oval. Give emotional variety and asymmetry. Make all12 large, clear and useful for planning SVG puppet corrective shapes.

assets.name: female-core
assets.prompt:
Create a 12-expression character design sheet of the SAME adult blue-haired woman from the reference. Retain green eyes, angular purple marking under her anatomical LEFT eye, asymmetrical chunky teal-blue bob, leather choker, simple dark slate shoulder armour. Flat SVG-friendly cel shapes, confident organic dark ink, thinner internal lines, no realistic rendering or gradients or added small armour/hair details. Warm ivory background. Landscape layout FOUR columns x THREE rows, 12 equally large head-and-shoulder poses, full margins, neat label below each.
This is EXPRESSION RANGE sheet1. Radically change head/jaw/cheeks/neck silhouette with emotions while keeping recognisable identity and adult proportions.
Reading order:
REST: guarded composure, cocked brow, little asymmetric mouth.
CURIOUS: craned neck, head tilted, brow high, eyes focus ahead.
SUSPICIOUS: chin back, eyes narrow sideways, one lip corner lifts.
SMUG: chin up and sideways, sly crooked grin, asymmetrical lids.
WARM SMILE: gentle genuine smile, cheeks raised, brows softened.
DELIGHT: cheeks expand wide, huge open grin, pinched joyful eyes.
LAUGHTER: head tilted back, enormous open mouth, squeezed eyes, shoulders lifting.
SURPRISE: round eyes and little round mouth, lifted head.
PANIC: stretched 150-percent-tall jaw/head, giant dark open mouth, tiny green pupils, recoiling shoulders and lifted hair.
ANNOYED: head sinks into collar, horizontal heavy lids, flat crooked lips.
ANGRY: broad compressed head, teeth clench, brows squeeze together.
FURIOUS: huge diagonal snarling shout, nose wrinkle, heavy down-sloping brows, thrust-forward head and bunched shoulders.
No extra speech bubbles or decoration. Same character and same costume throughout. Strong purposeful acting, not twelve mouths pasted on identical faces.

assets.name: male-mixed
assets.prompt:
Create sheet TWO: 12 distinctly different mixed and vulnerable expressions for the SAME adult dark-haired man in the supplied character study. Keep warm tan skin, dark messy chunky hair, expressive substantial nose, heavy brows, brown eyes, small moustache/chin stubble shapes, oversized charcoal-plum scarf, leather shoulders and muted bronze clasp. Match the reference's clean bold flat SVG-friendly cartoon art. No gradients, no painterly texture, no fine strands or detailed stubble. Warm ivory background, landscape FOUR columns x THREE rows. Twelve LARGE complete head-and-shoulder drawings, tiny labels below, generous margins.
Read order:
NERVOUS LAUGH: huge uneasy toothy grin, one brow up and one down, worried eyes, huddled shoulders.
HOLDING LAUGHTER: cheeks balloon, lips forcibly pressed closed crookedly, eyes squeezed, head compressed into scarf.
SUPPRESSED ANGER: tight lips puckered inward, pinched brows, narrowed sideways eyes, visibly tense jaw.
DISGUST: nose wrinkles, upper lip curls far up on one side, head withdraws diagonally.
MORTIFIED: enormous crooked tooth band grimace, eyes dodge down and aside, blush as flat shape, head sinks into scarf.
GUILTY: head lowers while eyes look upward, crooked apologetic mouth, one raised shoulder.
PLEADING: lifted inner brows, watery oversized eyes, lower lip pushed out, forward craning face.
GRIEF: head bowed, eyebrows slope high centrally, wide contorted crying mouth, heavy cheeks, tears.
EXHAUSTED: heavy half-lids and huge yawn, long loose face, head drooping sideways into scarf.
RELIEVED: eyes closed, lips loosely exhaling, cheeks soften, shoulders visibly drop.
DEFIANT: chin thrust up, challenge in eyes, one lip corner curls, chest proud.
DETERMINED: chin down, fixed concentrated eyes, brows strong, mouth decisively closed, forward intention.
REALLY change facial planes, skull/jaw silhouette, hair silhouette, neck and shoulders in every drawing. Blend emotions with asymmetry, adult appeal and theatrical acting. Make it a valuable expanded animation design sheet rather than repeated neutral heads.

assets.name: male-body
assets.prompt:
Create an EIGHT POSE FULL BODY ACTING concept sheet for the SAME adult man in the reference. Character identity: warm medium tan skin, dark messy black-brown chunky hair, brown eyes, heavy brows, substantial nose, restrained flat moustache/chin patch, huge charcoal-plum wrap scarf, simple dark leather tunic/shoulders, bronze clasp. Design rest of body in matching simple travel clothes: belt, fitted dark brown trousers, large practical boots, fingerless gloves. Compact stylised adult about 4.5 heads tall, no baby chibi. Match bold dark ink and flat cel color SVG game art. No gradients, small decorative details or textures.
LANDSCAPE sheet FOUR columns TWO rows, exactly EIGHT generous equally sized full-body panels with no visible frames; warm ivory negative space. ENTIRE boots, hair and hands stay inside each cell with wide margins and no overlaps. Small caption below each.
1 LISTEN: tall relaxed stance, one hip dropped, head tilts/eyes attentive, hand loosely holds scarf.
2 SNEAK: crouched low and forward, knees deeply bent, nose leads, hands delicately raised, scarf tail lags.
3 BRACE: large recoiling C-shaped body, one foot ahead braces, hands splayed toward unseen surprise, enormous shocked face.
4 ACCUSE: lunging directional pointing gesture, chest/head thrust forward, other fist at waist, brows angry.
5 PLEAD: crouched half-kneel, hands clasped in front, head raised and forward, emotional pleading face.
6 COLLAPSE LAUGHING: knees bent, torso folds hugely at waist, one hand on belly one knee, laughing tilted head, scarf drapes forward.
7 SHRINK: embarrassed hunch, head drawn down into enormous scarf, shoulders high, feet pigeon-toed, hands nervously together.
8 CELEBRATE: high one-leg hop, both arms thrown up asymmetrically, face huge laugh, scarf tail trailing, an indicated small ground shadow under raised boots.
Every pose must change line of action, spine, hips, head, arms and legs, showing elastic bodily acting rather than isolated face changes. Adult personality and strong clear silhouette at thumbnail size. Rig-friendly broad cloth shapes, one scarf wrap and one tail, simple glove hands.

assets.name: female-body
assets.prompt:
Create an EIGHT POSE FULL BODY ACTING concept sheet for the SAME adult woman in the reference. Preserve asymmetrical chunky teal-blue hair, green eyes, warm peach skin, purple angular marking under her anatomical LEFT eye, leather choker, simple slate chest armour and shoulder plates, dark gloves, trousers, sturdy boots and bronze belt buckle. Same bold curved dark ink and flat SVG-friendly cel shapes. No gradients, tiny decorations, textured rendering or extra accessories. Adult compact stylised proportions around 4.5 heads tall.
LANDSCAPE FOUR columns TWO rows, exactly EIGHT generously separated entire-body drawings, warm ivory background, caption below each, no borders. Keep every hand, boot, hair tip and motion accent in its cell. Significant whitespace between all drawings. SAME outfit in every pose.
1 LISTEN: upright asymmetrical relaxed stance, hand at hip, head tipped sideways, one brow raised.
2 SNEAK: deep low forward crouch, knees folded, nose/head lead, hands delicately raised, suspicious face.
3 BRACE: strong recoiling C-curve body with one boot braced forward, both hands splayed, big panic face and tall jaw.
4 ACCUSE: powerful pointing lunge, chest and head project forward, huge angry expression, other fist at hip.
5 PLEAD: half-kneeling, gloved hands clasped and extended, head raised with pleading eyes; even this proud woman can look vulnerable.
6 COLLAPSE LAUGHING: torso folded strongly forward, knees bent, one hand at belly and other on knee, huge laughing face.
7 SHRINK: mortified hunched shoulders, head sinks into choker/neck space, hand at face, feet close, crooked grimace.
8 CELEBRATE: joyful airborne one-leg hop, two arms up asymmetrically, laughing face, hair follows arc, small ground shadow.
Armour remains rigid plates ROTATED with shoulders and torso, not stretching like rubber. Exposed joints, cloth, neck and face can squash. Strong line of action, weight, emotional body language and clear thumbnail silhouettes. These are animation key pose concepts with pronounced acting.

assets.name: male-mouth
assets.prompt:
Create a professional TWELVE VISeme / talking mouth construction concept sheet for the SAME adult man in the reference. Identity: warm tan skin, substantial nose, small graphic moustache and chin stubble, tousled dark hair. Flat clean charcoal ink and cel-filled cartoon style, no realistic texture or gradients.
This sheet shows cropped LOWER-FACE STUDIES, NOT twelve complete portraits: from base of nose to chin, enough cheek contour around the mouth to show jaw shape. Same face orientation in every cell, very slight three-quarter turn. FOUR columns THREE rows on clean warm ivory, large mouths, generous spacing, numbered labels. No scarf should cover any mouth. Separate readable upper teeth band, lower teeth, tongue and dark interior only when they should be visible.
Each pose anatomically distinct, drawn as cartoon speech mechanics:
V00 REST: lips gently closed, relaxed jaw.
V01 M B P: lips firmly pressed with visible compression, no teeth showing, cheeks slightly pressured.
V02 AH: big open vertically stretched jaw, dark interior, upper tooth band and low relaxed tongue.
V03 EH UH: medium open relaxed mouth, less jaw drop than AH.
V04 EE IH: corners spread wide, thin horizontal opening, upper teeth visible.
V05 OH: lips shaped as LARGE open O, jaw dropped, rounded lip contour.
V06 OO W: tight small puckered rounded opening, projected lips.
V07 F V: upper front teeth visibly contact the LOWER LIP, lower lip tucked in, no large open oval.
V08 L: mouth medium open, TONGUE TIP raised and visible touching just behind upper teeth.
V09 TH: tongue tip visibly projects BETWEEN upper and lower teeth, small forward tongue, distinct from L.
V10 S Z: teeth nearly together leaving a narrow gap, lips slightly apart/spread.
V11 SH CH J: lips project/round softly, teeth near each other, small opening larger than OO.
Use exactly those12 labels under the corresponding drawing. Lip shapes and jaw/cheek contour should be clearly varied and mechanically meaningful. Keep same skin and ink palette, moustache design and facial identity in all cells. This is a concept guide for editable SVG mouth paths and teeth/tongue layers, not polished anatomical realism.
